title: A predicate on actual-source objects does not cover a relaxation
situation: Conservatively models the actual-realizable locus as tighter than the relaxed summit locus until Lean makes the projection definitional.

inputs.source_object: Summit retaining pair and descent provenance

attempted_conclusion: Carry a predicate proved only on actual-source objects to every relaxed summit object.

expected.reason: Forgetting provenance enlarges the region, so an actual-source predicate need not hold on all relaxed objects.
